messages:
Rebecca: t-minus 36h to cutoff. Please make sure version bumps + changelog entries are in PRs or they'll be held. Ping me when you're done. @Alex @Maya
Alex: On it. I'll finish the v2.4.1 bump and push changelog entry today. ETA 2h.
Maya: I'll do a quick pass on outstanding release PRs and flag any missing changelogs. If tests are flaky I'll mark them.
Luis: Heads-up — CI showing a couple failures in integration-shard-3. Re-running now: `ci re-run 2442003145`.
CI-Bot: re-run started for pipeline #3421 (release-branch). Current status: queued -> running.
Sam: FYI failing test is `tests/e2e/replication::test_reconnect` — that's been flaky before. Repro locally takes 2 min.
Alex: If it's flaky, please add `flake:investigate` label and post a short log snippet here. We'll exclude from green sweep only if triaged.
Maya: Quick checklist for green sweep:
- All release PRs merged to `release/v2.4`
- Version bump + changelog in each PR
- No open regressions / flake tags if untriaged
- Run `scripts/ci/green-sweep --branch release/v2.4`
Luis: After re-run: one transient timeout fixed, one still failing (same reconnect). Pasted failure:
```
ERROR tests/e2e/replication::test_reconnect - TimeoutError: client reconnect timed out after 60s
trace: connection.py:213
```
Rebecca: Okay mark that as `flake:investigate` and move on. We need overall green for cutoff. If it keeps failing after two reruns, we'll pin and bypass with approval from eng leads.
Sam: I'll open a quick PR with a retries wrapper for that test and a note in the changelog; won't block cutoff but leaves trace.
Alex: Reminder: avoid changing unrelated infra in release PRs. If you must, call it out in the PR description so checkout teams can coordinate.
Rebecca: Thanks — doing a merge sweep at 09:00 UTC. I'll post a final "cutoff now" message 30m before. :hourglass:
